title: Resultant flow out of a set as a sum over singleton vertices
statement:
Let $N$ be a network on a finite vertex set $V$, let $f$ assign a nonnegative integer $f(u,v)$ to each ordered pair of vertices $u,v$, and let $S\subseteq V$. Summing the resultant flow out of a singleton $\{v\}$ over all vertices $v\in S$ recovers the resultant flow out of $S$; that is, the following identity holds in $\bbz$:
\[
  \sum_{v\in S}\bigl(f^{+}(\{v\})-f^{-}(\{v\})\bigr)=f^{+}(S)-f^{-}(S).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f assigns a nonnegative integer to each ordered pair of vertices (f : V → V → ℕ)
S is a subset of the vertex set
the vertex set V is finite
